answer: Tie each agent to a jetty it can't move: once an epoch, 5 random verifiers in different regions ping it and record round-trip times. Keys whose latency fingerprints match within 2 ms are merged into one seat, so clones can't wander between identities on a single server. Every real identity needs its own machine in its own place, about $4 a month; 100 fakes cost $400 monthly, and pooling them collapses them to one. Rewards stay locked like jade in a case until a fingerprint holds for 3 epochs.
